hooks.text: Two dead stars smashed together and forged cosmic supplies of gold.
Where did the universe forge its heaviest caches of gold?
One cosmic collision forged an entire planetary mass of gold.
The deadliest stellar collision created our most precious heavy metals.

title: How Dead Stars Forged the Universe's Gold
description: When two neutron stars collided over 130 million light-years away, their kilonova explosion forged cosmic supplies of gold and uranium.

beats.text: Two dead stars smashed together and forged cosmic supplies of gold.
beats.visual: Artist concept of two merging neutron stars producing a kilonova, ESO, 2017
queries: Neutron star merger artist impression ESO

beats.text: In 2017, observatories detected ripples in spacetime from a collision over 130 million light-years away.
beats.visual: Aerial view of the LIGO Hanford Observatory in Washington, 2017

beats.text: Two ultra-dense neutron stars spiraled together, detonating a fireball roughly 1,000 times brighter than a classical nova.
beats.visual: Hubble Space Telescope image of galaxy NGC 4993 and kilonova, 2017

beats.text: The violent crash unleashed a flood of neutrons, driving the rapid neutron-capture process.
beats.visual: Artist illustration of neutron flux during binary merger, NASA, 2017
queries: Neutron star merger artist impression ESO

beats.text: This extreme forge synthesized heavy elements like gold and uranium that normal stars cannot produce.
beats.visual: Spectroscopic visualization of heavy elements in AT 2017gfo debris, ESO, 2019

beats.text: These heavy elements blocked blue light, turning the expanding cloud a distinct glowing red.
beats.visual: Optical discovery image of AT 2017gfo from Swope telescope, 2017

beats.text: Spectral models revealed the explosive debris fireball expanded as an almost perfect sphere.
beats.visual: Numerical simulation of the spherical kilonova fireball geometry, 2023
queries: Neutron star merger artist impression ESO

beats.text: The heaviest metals in our cosmos required complete destruction.
beats.visual: Artist impression of black hole remnant following neutron star merger, ESO, 2017
queries: Neutron star merger artist impression ESO

better_than_last: Applies lessons from ep084 and ep114 by accelerating cosmic scale reveals and spotlighting the spherical fireball twist without dense academic jargon.
